title: SIFMA-recommended Japan fixed-income early close, 3:00 p.m. JST — the BoJ Summary of Opinions prints into a shortened Tokyo bond session
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 298,926 bytes) and parsed card-by-card (h3 name / date / note) with region attribution fixed to the page's own 'U.S. / U.K. / Japan Holiday Recommendations' <h2> section headings by this session — 35 cards in the Japan panel. The card parses exactly as ['Boxing Day', 'Early Close Only (3:00 p.m. Japan Standard Time): Monday, December 28, 2026'] — i.e. SIFMA recommends its members' Japanese fixed-income desks close at 15:00 JST on 2026-12-28. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the source is NON-BINDING BY ITS OWN TERMS — a recommendation to members, not exchange hours. Precedent for the class: the calendar already carries sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31, -2027-03-25 and -2027-05-28, all filed on the same page's US panel
notes: DISCOVERED during the jpx-market-closure-2026-12-31 initial research (2026-09-05), leg 10. The discovering lane for that event (sifma-bond-early-close-2026-12-31) parsed SIFMA's Japan panel and reported its 12-31 'Bank Holiday' card, but not this 12-28 early-close card three days earlier; this session re-parsed all 35 Japan cards and found it. WHY IT EARNS A ROW: 2026-12-28 is already a tracked date carrying boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-12-28 (the October 29-30 MPM Summary, published 08:50 JST) and advance-economic-indicators-2026-12-28. If this recommendation holds, that BoJ publication prints into a Japanese fixed-income session that SIFMA members are recommended to close at 15:00 JST — roughly a half session for the reaction, three days before Tokyo goes fully dark for 99 hours over the year-end (jpx-market-closure-2026-12-31). It is the FIRST Japan-panel SIFMA entry on this calendar; the three existing sifma-* entries are all US-panel. NOTE THE NAME MISMATCH, deliberately preserved: SIFMA files the card under the heading 'Boxing Day', a UK/Commonwealth holiday with no standing in Japan (2026-12-28 is an ordinary JPX business day and not a Japanese national holiday) — the recommendation appears to track cross-border settlement convenience rather than a local closure, and this entry's title describes the effect rather than repeating SIFMA's heading. IMPACT LOW: a recommended early close in a foreign fixed-income market moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for 'holiday|jpx|tokyo|nikkei|closure|year-end|new year': zero hits in both), and this repo tracks no Japan-listed symbol or JGB instrument. It changes how the 12-28 BoJ publication is READ, not what anything is worth. HONEST LIMIT: JPX itself is OPEN and on normal hours on 2026-12-28 — both JPX panels were re-parsed this session and neither lists it — so this is a recommendation to bond desks, NOT an exchange closure, and the two must not be conflated. A related divergence from the same panel, recorded but not filed: SIFMA's Japan panel also carries 'Christmas Day / Friday, December 25, 2026', a date on which JPX trades normally and this calendar already tracks japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-12-25.
